distribution.summary: 安徽; 四川; 贵州; 福建; 广西; 云南; 西藏; 台湾
distribution.narrative: 黄复生等 (2015) reports 安徽、四川、贵州、福建、广西、云南、西藏. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the first Taiwan record from Nantou, Huison and Pingtung, Shantimen.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) provides six explicit host taxa, which are retained at their published resolution. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds only the broad statement 'Polyphagous on angiosperms', so no additional host taxon is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes cyperi (Beeson, 1929).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Coccotrypes cyperi (Beeson, 1929), VSN_1167, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. 黄复生等 (2015) uses the source spelling Coccotrypes cypri; Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Coccotrypes cyperi (Beeson). Source-specific spellings are preserved without changing the stable VSN.
